Ghana Property Inspection Checklist

Comprehensive 60-item inspection checklist covering structural, electrical, plumbing, appliances, and external features. Automated register tracks findings, costs, and compliance issues.

What's Included

  • 60-Item Checklist: Comprehensive assessment covering all property aspects
  • Fillable PDF: Professional form for printing and digital completion
  • Interactive HTML App: Browser-based form with real-time calculations (Manager & Portfolio tiers)
  • Automated Excel Register: Track all inspections, findings, costs, and follow-up actions
  • Color-Coded Ratings: Green (good), Yellow (needs attention), Red (urgent repair)
  • Cost Tracking: Budget for required repairs and maintenance
  • PDF Guide: Step-by-step inspection instructions for property managers
  • WhatsApp Cards: 5 marketing cards (Portfolio tier only)
  • Offline-first: No subscriptions, works in PDF reader and Excel.

Inspection Categories

  • Structure & Safety: Foundation, walls, roof, windows, doors, locks
  • Electrical Systems: Wiring, outlets, switches, circuit breaker, lighting
  • Plumbing: Water supply, drainage, fixtures, water heater
  • Kitchen & Appliances: Stove, refrigerator, sink, cabinets, countertops
  • Bathrooms: Fixtures, tiles, ventilation, water pressure
  • Flooring & Walls: Condition, cleanliness, damage, paint
  • Exterior: Fence, gates, yard, drainage, parking

Act 220 Compliant: Inspection process and documentation align with Ghana's Rent Act, 1963 requirements for property condition assessment and dispute documentation.
